summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test of Easy Expense app. All 17 pytest backend tests passed (100%) including AI receipt scan with OpenAI gpt-5.4 (extracted vendor 'Blue Bottle Coffee' correctly), file storage/serve, expenses CRUD w/ filters, projects, reports summary (week/month/quarter/year) and CSV export. Frontend mobile smoke via Playwright (390x844): home dashboard renders hero total ($340,610.32), bento (Top Category=Fuel), recent expenses list, Scan Receipt CTA. Expenses tab: search + horizontal filter chips + list all functional. Add tab: form validation shows 'Enter a valid amount' correctly. Reports tab: period segmented control and Export CSV render. Scan screen: mounts (camera permission gate visible with 'Upload from gallery instead' fallback). All testIDs present. Two non-blocking React-Native-Web console warnings: deprecated shadow* style props and props.pointerEvents.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/web. Reference: shadow definitions used across screens (index.tsx, reports.tsx, scan.tsx, etc.)
React-Native-Web warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/scan.tsx:190

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN Web deprecation warnings
Optional: move pointerEvents='none' from prop to style on scan.tsx reticle View (line ~190)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses uuid string ids and excludes MongoDB _id via Pydantic (Expense model has no _id) — good.
api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env — good.
All interactive elements have testID attributes.
server.py list_expenses has no _id issue because Expense(**d) reconstructs from doc — verified in tests (JSON parses cleanly).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all screens mount, all core interactions work)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed data (TEST_Blue Bottle expense, TEST_Client A project); expense is deleted at end of run (project remains — safe naming).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py. Uses Pillow to generate a realistic receipt JPEG for /api/scan tests. AI extraction currently succeeds; if key is revoked, extraction_failed=true is a valid response too.
